meta.objective: After this lesson the student can ...

steps.title: Hook
steps.say: Connect to something the student already knows, while the title and one concrete drawing appear.

steps.title: Part one
steps.say: Introduce the first part by name, in its own color, as it is drawn.

steps.title: Part two
steps.say: Introduce the second part the same way.

steps.title: The idea
steps.say: State the rule in plain words. Then show it as notation.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.say: Ask the student to predict the next result. Pause and work it out before you continue.

steps.title: The answer
steps.say: Reveal the answer and say why in one sentence.

steps.title: Remember
steps.say: One short sentence that restates the takeaway.
